title: Urban Vertical Model-Scouting Field Lab and Competitive Signal Play
creator: Sofia Reyes
description: Run a focused field lab to evaluate candidate open and managed models for three urban vertical use cases (real-estate search, municipal knowledge assistant, and last-mile routing summarization). Objective: produce an evidence-backed ranked catalog of models, quantify latency/cost/perf tradeoffs on representative workloads, surface integration risk, and recommend fallback flavors (quantized vs full-precision) for Redwood serving. Deliverables: annotated model catalog CSV, 6 canonical prompt sets + expected-output templates, a short technical appendix with quantization compatibility notes, and a go/no-go recommendation for pilot customers. Scope excludes large-scale procurement negotiations and deep fine-tuning experiments — this is scouting and readiness assessment for serving at Redwood.
success_metrics: Annotated catalog covering >=12 candidate model variants with standardized scorecards
Per-use-case latency P95 under target thresholds or clear mitigation strategy
Estimated per-token cost delta vs baseline for top-3 choices
Compatibility notes for Dedicated and Private deployments for each recommended variant
acceptance_criteria: Catalog CSV uploaded to /datasets/urban-field-lab with model fingerprints and kernel affinity notes
Bench results reproducible via instructions in the lab README
Product recommendation memo with one-page summary and prioritized next steps accepted by PM and Runtime lead
Hand-off checklist for solutions engineering with integration risk tags
